from solution import dispatch_frames


class DispatchFramesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preserves_frame_and_handler_order_and_completes_last(self):
        events = []

        def first(frame):
            events.append(("first", frame))
            return f"first:{frame}"

        def second(frame):
            events.append(("second", frame))
            return f"second:{frame}"

        def complete(results):
            events.append(("complete", results))
            self.assertIsInstance(results, tuple)
            return {"results": results}

        result = dispatch_frames(["a", "b"], [first, second], complete)
        expected_results = (
            "first:a", "second:a", "first:b", "second:b"
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, {"results": expected_results})
        self.assertEqual(events, [
            ("first", "a"),
            ("second", "a"),
            ("first", "b"),
            ("second", "b"),
            ("complete", expected_results),
        ])

    def test_accepts_one_shot_iterables(self):
        calls = []

        def make_handler(name):
            def handler(frame):
                calls.append((name, frame))
                return (name, frame)
            return handler

        frames = (value for value in [1, 2, 3])
        handlers = (handler for handler in [make_handler("x"), make_handler("y")])
        result = dispatch_frames(frames, handlers, lambda values: values)

        self.assertEqual(result, (
            ("x", 1), ("y", 1),
            ("x", 2), ("y", 2),
            ("x", 3), ("y", 3),
        ))
        self.assertEqual(calls, [
            ("x", 1), ("y", 1),
            ("x", 2), ("y", 2),
            ("x", 3), ("y", 3),
        ])

    def test_empty_frames_calls_completion_once_with_empty_tuple(self):
        received = []

        def complete(results):
            received.append(results)
            return "done"

        self.assertEqual(dispatch_frames([], [lambda value: value], complete), "done")
        self.assertEqual(received, [()])

    def test_empty_handlers_still_calls_completion(self):
        completion_count = 0

        def complete(results):
            nonlocal completion_count
            completion_count += 1
            self.assertEqual(results, ())
            return 17

        self.assertEqual(dispatch_frames([1, 2], [], complete), 17)
        self.assertEqual(completion_count, 1)

    def test_does_not_mutate_input_lists(self):
        frames = [1, 2]
        handlers = [lambda value: value, lambda value: value * 10]
        original_frames = list(frames)
        original_handlers = list(handlers)

        dispatch_frames(frames, handlers, lambda results: results)

        self.assertEqual(frames, original_frames)
        self.assertEqual(handlers, original_handlers)
        self.assertIs(handlers[0], original_handlers[0])
        self.assertIs(handlers[1], original_handlers[1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from solution import ContinuationNotifier


class ContinuationNotifierTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_publish_notifies_in_registration_order_and_records_publication_order(self):
        calls = []

        def first(page, caption):
            calls.append(("first", page, caption))

        def second(page, caption):
            calls.append(("second", page, caption))

        def complete(history):
            calls.append(("complete", history))
            self.assertIsInstance(history, tuple)
            return "finished"

        notifier = ContinuationNotifier([first, second], complete)
        notifier.publish(2, "two")
        notifier.publish(1, "one")

        self.assertEqual(notifier.finish(), "finished")
        expected_history = ((2, "two"), (1, "one"))
        self.assertEqual(calls, [
            ("first", 2, "two"),
            ("second", 2, "two"),
            ("first", 1, "one"),
            ("second", 1, "one"),
            ("complete", expected_history),
        ])

    def test_listener_iterable_is_consumed_and_stored_at_construction(self):
        calls = []

        def listener_a(page, caption):
            calls.append("a")

        def listener_b(page, caption):
            calls.append("b")

        listeners = (listener for listener in [listener_a, listener_b])
        notifier = ContinuationNotifier(listeners, lambda history: history)
        notifier.publish(1, "caption")

        self.assertEqual(calls, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(notifier.finish(), ((1, "caption"),))

    def test_finish_without_publications_completes_once(self):
        histories = []
        sentinel = object()

        def complete(history):
            histories.append(history)
            return sentinel

        notifier = ContinuationNotifier([], complete)
        self.assertIs(notifier.finish(), sentinel)
        self.assertIs(notifier.finish(), sentinel)
        self.assertEqual(histories, [()])

    def test_repeated_finish_caches_none_result(self):
        count = 0

        def complete(history):
            nonlocal count
            count += 1
            return None

        notifier = ContinuationNotifier([], complete)
        self.assertIsNone(notifier.finish())
        self.assertIsNone(notifier.finish())
        self.assertEqual(count, 1)

    def test_publish_after_finish_raises_without_notifying(self):
        calls = []
        notifier = ContinuationNotifier(
            [lambda page, caption: calls.append((page, caption))],
            lambda history: history,
        )
        self.assertEqual(notifier.finish(), ())

        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            notifier.publish(9, "late")

        self.assertEqual(calls, [])
        self.assertEqual(notifier.finish(), ())

    def test_instances_have_isolated_history_and_completion(self):
        first = ContinuationNotifier([], lambda history: ("first", history))
        second = ContinuationNotifier([], lambda history: ("second", history))
        first.publish(1, "a")
        second.publish(2, "b")

        self.assertEqual(first.finish(), ("first", ((1, "a"),)))
        self.assertEqual(second.finish(), ("second", ((2, "b"),)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class DependencyWalksTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_depth_first_preorder_and_neighbor_order(self):
        graph = {
            "app": ["db", "api"],
            "db": ["disk", "shared"],
            "api": ["shared", "auth"],
            "auth": [],
        }

        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, ["app"]), {
            "app": ("app", "db", "disk", "shared", "api", "auth")
        })

    def test_cycle_and_repeated_references_visit_each_node_once(self):
        graph = {
            "a": ["b", "b", "c"],
            "b": ["c", "a"],
            "c": ["a"],
        }
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, ["a"]), {
            "a": ("a", "b", "c")
        })

    def test_missing_nodes_are_leaves(self):
        graph = {"root": ["missing", "known"], "known": ["other-missing"]}
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, ["root", "missing"]), {
            "root": ("root", "missing", "known", "other-missing"),
            "missing": ("missing",),
        })

    def test_each_root_has_fresh_visited_state(self):
        graph = {
            "left": ["shared"],
            "right": ["shared"],
            "shared": ["leaf"],
        }
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, ["left", "right"]), {
            "left": ("left", "shared", "leaf"),
            "right": ("right", "shared", "leaf"),
        })

    def test_no_state_persists_between_calls(self):
        graph = {"a": ["b"], "b": []}
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, ["a"]), {"a": ("a", "b")})
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, ["b", "a"]), {
            "b": ("b",),
            "a": ("a", "b"),
        })

    def test_empty_roots_returns_empty_dictionary(self):
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks({"a": ["b"]}, []), {})

    def test_supports_one_shot_root_and_neighbor_iterables(self):
        graph = {
            "left": (node for node in ["shared"]),
            "right": (node for node in ["shared"]),
            "shared": (node for node in ["leaf"]),
        }
        roots = (root for root in ["left", "right"])
        self.assertEqual(dependency_walks(graph, roots), {
            "left": ("left", "shared", "leaf"),
            "right": ("right", "shared", "leaf"),
        })

    def test_does_not_mutate_graph_or_roots(self):
        graph = {"a": ["b", "c"], "b": ["c"], "c": []}
        roots = ["a", "b"]
        original_graph = {key: list(value) for key, value in graph.items()}
        original_roots = list(roots)

        dependency_walks(graph, roots)

        self.assertEqual(graph, original_graph)
        self.assertEqual(roots, original_roots)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        forest.add("alpha", "root")
        forest.add("middle", "root")
        forest.add("z-child", "zeta")
        forest.add("a-z", "alpha")
        forest.add("a-a", "alpha")

        self.assertEqual(forest.pending_postorder("root"), (
            "a-a", "a-z", "alpha",
            "middle",
            "z-child", "zeta",
            "root",
        ))

    def test_postorder_can_start_at_non_root(self):
        forest = ContainerForest()
        forest.add("top")
        forest.add("branch", "top")
        forest.add("leaf-2", "branch")
        forest.add("leaf-1", "branch")
        forest.add("other", "top")

        self.assertEqual(
            forest.pending_postorder("branch"),
            ("leaf-1", "leaf-2", "branch"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(forest.pending_postorder("leaf-1"), ("leaf-1",))

    def test_multiple_roots_remain_separate(self):
        forest = ContainerForest()
        forest.add("root-b")
        forest.add("b-child", "root-b")
        forest.add("root-a")
        forest.add("a-child", "root-a")

        self.assertEqual(forest.route("a-child"), ("root-a", "a-child"))
        self.assertEqual(forest.route("b-child"), ("root-b", "b-child"))
        self.assertEqual(
            forest.pending_postorder("root-a"),
            ("a-child", "root-a"),
        )

        second = ContainerForest()
        first.add("same-root")
        second.add("same-root")
        first.add("only-first", "same-root")
        second.add("only-second", "same-root")

        self.assertEqual(

            ("only-first", "same-root"),

        self.assertEqual(

            ("only-second", "same-root"),

            tuple(reversed(expected)),
